notes.title: Service Suspension Announcement
notes.notes:
【Notice of Delisting of "Abyss Contract"】
Since the game was launched, it has received strong support and love from the majority of players. Looking back on the countless happy times we have spent with everyone these days, the operation and all staff are sincerely grateful for everyone's support and help! Due to the adjustment of the operation strategy, the game has to go through the process of delisting and shutting down the server. We express our deep regret and apology for the inconvenience caused to everyone! We will do our best to provide the final operation service, and hope to let you have a wonderful game experience in the end!
--------------------
After closing the recharge, compensation will be issued: Diamonds*20000+Points*10000+Small Silver Hammer*100+Advanced Strengthening Stone*100
--------------------
Specific time is:
Notification time: May 20, 2025
Stop recharge: June 16, 2025
Stop login: July 16, 2025
